title: Spectral infinity norm
statement: For $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define its spectral infinity norm to be $\max_{\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n}|\widehat f(\gamma)|$, where $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is its vector Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$.
